component.name: io.maretha.audit.forwarder.AuditForwarderService
component.documentation: Forwards Nuxeo audit events to the sinks declared in nuxeo.conf. Configuration is contributed by audit-forwarder-config.xml; built-in sink types by audit-forwarder-sinks.xml.

extension-point.name: configuration
extension-point.documentation: Single forwarder configuration. A later contribution replaces the earlier one.

extension-point.name: sinkTypes
extension-point.documentation: Maps a sink type, as written in maretha.audit.forwarder.sink.<name>.type, to the io.maretha.audit.forwarder.sink.AuditSinkFactory that builds it. Contribute your own to add a destination:
